title: Find your busywork
intro: Copy this into ChatGPT or Claude, fill in the brackets, and send.
prompt:
I'm a real estate agent. Here are the tasks I repeat every week and about how long each takes:
[list them, for example: texting new leads back, 3 hours; writing listing descriptions, 2 hours; updating my CRM, 2 hours]
Rank them by how much AI could help, biggest time saver first. For the top three, tell me in plain words what AI can do and what I should still do myself, then write me a ready-to-use prompt for each one. Ask me up to three questions first if anything is unclear. Don't ask for client names or private details.
promptNote: What you'll get back: a short ranked list and three prompts you can use tomorrow.
homework: Run the prompt and hit reply on the Clear Signal email with your top three. Tony reads every one.
